card.name: Eye symptom lists before vision loss
card.fires_on: Commas, 'or', 'include' and similar linking words inside lists of eye warning symptoms (flashing lights, floaters, eye pain) where 'vision loss' or an eye term comes next. Also fires on a name token in an eye-research news item.

modes.label: Eye symptom lists
modes.description: Punctuation or 'or' between listed eye symptoms such as floaters, flashes, eye pain, right before vision-related words.
modes.example: Patients should be advised to seek immediate care with sudden onset of flashing lights, floaters,<< or>> vision loss.

modes.label: Retinal detachment text
modes.description: Linking words in retina descriptions where symptoms of detachment are about to be named.
modes.example: Symptoms of retinal detachment<< include>> an increase in the number of floaters

card.writes: It pushes the model toward vision and eye words such as vision, visual and eyes as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot in an eye-warning list where a word like vision loss or eye is likely to come next.
